why: Cancel click sets g_lastClickTick, so a held head is already dropped via cancelClick. Only an unsent, not-engine-held head (round list full) survives doCancel; narrow window.
fix: Add endHandoff(k, qh::DR_CANCEL) in doCancel but forward-declare endHandoff (defined line 1057, after doCancel at 817); Gemini diff alone will not compile.
title: Cancel during soft combat does not clear g_handoff

why: Raw s.haveCur sets actionPresent before creal; activeVerdict rule 1 has no timeout, so a stale flagless 9/10 cur keeps buf.active in AV_PRESENT and blocks DS_ACTIVE. rn[] is the pending list, not cur.
fix: Gemini fix OK (move stale bookkeeping and creal above actionInQueue, gate cur check on creal). rn[] loop stays raw: no stale rule exists and nrn blocks dispatch anyway.
gate: extract actionInQueue cur test to QueueHudLogic.h + unit test (stale 9/10 cur => not present); play-test the stall
title: actionInQueue uses raw haveCur before creal

why: Hooks pass raw haveCur to decideAction while the tick dispatch gate uses curReal. A ghost sub-1 cur buffers an idle use; tick replays next frame, but inMenu returns early so inventory uses wait for menu close.
fix: Gemini fix OK: compute haveCur in queueCountOf with qh::curReal and the buffer's staleCurSince (0 when k out of range).
gate: play-test: use item from inventory right after combat
title: queueCountOf passes raw haveCur to decideAction

why: Code comment at 1498 documents the head drop as intended. Engine-held head is dropped correctly (engine runs it); only an unsent head (round full) can be lost, and combat must end in that few-frame window.
fix: Restore head only when headValid && !headHeld && !sawExec (never for an engine-held or executed head), then markDispatched; Gemini unconditional restore risks a double run.
title: Combat end drops pending g_handoff head

why: Tab/portrait switch in combat is not gated in code and the identity pre-pass is skipped in combat/menu, so gating reads and ServerClearAllActions can hit the wrong slot. Dispatch uses a.creature, limiting damage.
fix: Extract the swap into a helper that also swaps g_handoff, g_flagGate, g_roundOrder, g_lastOurs; call it before the combat/menu branch and in doCancel. Swapping g_itemQueue alone leaves state mismatched.
title: Party rotation vs slot-indexed state in combat

why: Both paths real, but severity lowered from Haiku medium: path 1 needs both non-default hide_*_soft=0 (soft HUD reverts to hard-combat hiding); path 2 is a one-frame Cancel/panel flicker on a rare unreadable flag frame.
fix: Gemini fix OK: return on g_combatUnreadable before touching g_softCombat, and move the both-off early return after g_softCombat = soft. Hunk line numbers are stale.
gate: play-test: hide_banner_soft=0 hide_redbar_soft=0 in soft combat
title: softBannerTick clears g_softCombat before early returns

why: drawAll, drawStrips and the drawLeader log label use raw g_combat. Visible effect needs show_in_combat=0 (default 1); default config only mislabels hidden(combat) vs empty queue.
fix: Gemini fix OK (use hardCombat in all three sites); diff line numbers are stale (774, 597, 712).
title: drawAll/drawLeader/drawStrips gate on raw g_combat

why: The fill==2 latch is intentional (set text once per show), but cwShow resets fill to -1 on hide and setFill never clears the label text, so an X set on a miss stays over the art after a later success.
fix: Clear the text with setText(w.c, "") on every successful setFill when a per-control xText flag is set (fill is -1 after reshow, so Gemini's fill==2 test never fires); drop the latch only on retry.
title: cwLookCompanion latches text X after fill fallback

why: On an unreadable frame g_combat is forced to 1, so edgeTick logs EDGE combat src=unreadable, then a second edge src=hud. Trace only, and the first line is already labelled; no gameplay effect.
fix: Gemini fix OK: skip pCombat updates while g_combatUnreadable (loses the labelled unreadable edge, acceptable).
title: edgeTick logs false combat edges on unreadable frames
